content_units: Team Karaoke Shortlist for Nervous Singers

A crowd-friendly set should favor familiar choruses, moderate tempos, short runtimes, and forgiving vocal ranges. This mix spans classic hits through recent pop, with plenty of picks that work well even if half the room joins in.
20 Easy, Fun Karaoke Picks
Song   Artist   Decade   Difficulty   Best For
1   Dancing Queen   ABBA   1970s   Easy   Group
2   Sweet Caroline   Neil Diamond   1960s   Easy   Group
3   I Wanna Dance with Somebody   Whitney Houston   1980s   Medium   Group
4   Livin' on a Prayer   Bon Jovi   1980s   Medium   Group
5   Don't Stop Believin'   Journey   1980s   Medium   Group
6   Summer Nights   John Travolta & Olivia Newton-John   1970s   Easy   Duet
7   Islands in the Stream   Kenny Rogers & Dolly Parton   1980s   Easy   Duet
8   Love Shack   The B-52's   1980s   Easy   Group
9   Man! I Feel Like a Woman!   Shania Twain   1990s   Easy   Group
10   Wonderwall   Oasis   1990s   Easy   Solo
11   ...Baby One More Time   Britney Spears   1990s   Easy   Solo
12   Wannabe   Spice Girls   1990s   Easy   Group
13   Valerie   Mark Ronson feat. Amy Winehouse   2000s   Easy   Solo
14   Hey Ya!   OutKast   2000s   Medium   Group
15   Mr. Brightside   The Killers   2000s   Medium   Group
16   Since U Been Gone   Kelly Clarkson   2000s   Medium   Group
17   Shake It Off   Taylor Swift   2010s   Easy   Group
18   Uptown Funk   Mark Ronson feat. Bruno Mars   2010s   Easy   Group
19   Shallow   Lady Gaga & Bradley Cooper   2010s   Medium   Duet
20   Flowers   Miley Cyrus   2020s   Easy   Solo
Best Picks by Comfort Level
Option 1: Safest crowd-pleasers   Big choruses, easy audience participation, low pressure     Best for nervous groups
- Sweet Caroline
- Dancing Queen
- Love Shack
- Shake It Off
- Uptown Funk
Option 2: Best duet saves   Shared verses reduce pressure and create instant chemistry     Best for pairs
- Summer Nights
- Islands in the Stream
- Shallow
Option 3: Easy solo wins   Recognizable, manageable, and not overly demanding     Best for first-time singers
- Wonderwall
- Valerie
- Flowers
- ...Baby One More Time
Option 4: High-energy if the room is warmed up   More fun than hard, but need confidence on the chorus     Best later in the night
- Livin' on a Prayer
- Don't Stop Believin'
- Mr. Brightside
- Since U Been Gone
Smart Running Order for a Team Social
- Start with group-safe songs:   Sweet Caroline  ,   Dancing Queen  ,   Wannabe
- Move into duet comfort picks:   Summer Nights  ,   Islands in the Stream
- Use easy solos once confidence rises:   Valerie  ,   Wonderwall  ,   Flowers
- Save bigger singalong anthems for later:   Don't Stop Believin'  ,   Mr. Brightside  ,   Uptown Funk

Selection Notes
- Chosen for   high recognition  ,   group singalong value  ,   mostly comfortable ranges  , and   short-to-moderate song length  .
- Duet/group-friendly picks included:   Sweet Caroline, Dancing Queen, Summer Nights, Islands in the Stream, Love Shack, Wannabe, Shake It Off, Uptown Funk, Shallow  .
- A few “medium” songs are included because they are so well known that the crowd usually carries the performance.
